title: Restore Fly token credential for NHS scheduled worker wrappers
acceptance_criteria: Restore a macOS Keychain item with account foundry and service fly-api-token, or update the repo wrappers if the canonical service name changed.
Do not print, echo, commit, or copy the Fly token; verify presence only through wrapper execution or redacted boolean/exit-code checks.
Run ./tools/monitor-check.sh with no dry-run variables and confirm it no longer logs fly token missing.
Record non-secret proof in an ops ledger before any monitor marketing expansion.

title: Capture fresh live monitor-check proof after Fly credential repair
acceptance_criteria: Re-run ./tools/monitor-check.sh from the repo root with no dry-run variables.
Verify tools/monitor-check.log contains live remote output from /app/monitor-check, not only local wrapper output.
Accept either monitor-check: 0 due monitors or monitor-check: N due monitors followed by remote monitor-check done.
Update the monitor-check proof ledger with the exact timestamp and aggregate due count only.
